description: Parse a company number and its registered identity, status and address. Paid deep adds business activity and associated identifiers. Geography lookups are separate calls.

country.description: ISO2, ISO3, or a country name. Optional when the lookup is unique.

deep.description: Include the nested deep object when available. Pricing depends on the operation.

lang.description: Optional display language, such as fr or zh-Hant. IDs, numeric values and input parsing stay unchanged.

number.description: Company registration number, e.g. 552100554 with country FR

name: company
title: Company
